name: ANSI/IEEE Capacitive proximity switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of capacitive proximity switch: a capacitive proximity switch detects a target through a change in its sensing capacitance.
description: This reference locates capacitive proximity switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented capacitive switches family. A capacitive proximity switch detects a target through a change in its sensing capacitance. Its supply and switching output are shown separately from the target or process material. The public library uses HPX1C for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Read sensitivity and target conditions from the product selection. Capacitive sensing is different from inductive metal-target sensing. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
